name: drive mobiliesam inference on cpu from a prompt
definition: Load the distilled SAM model weights, run inference on the CPU, ordering the image/masks use prompts derived from each rectangular region to produce per-cell segmentation masks.

name: embed documents at a fixed revision, rank, and return the selected document
definition: Encode documents and the query with the pinned model revision, rank by cosine similarity, and return the assigned position.
failure_mode: revision mismatch, stale cache, or different injection gives a different similarity ordering

name: emit vocabulary and merge-rule files in the exact format a given tokenizer loads
definition: Write one token per line and one space-separated merge pair per line, matching the loading convention of a provided script.
failure_mode: Malformed or misordered merge lines break or change loading

name: estimate an average treatment effect to high accuracy
definition: Fit the outcome model with an appropriate adjustment set and compute the ATE, then write a single number whose value is within a tight tolerance of the true effect.
failure_mode: Wrong adjustment set dilutes the estimate or formatting/scale error.
